## History

Kenneth died when he fell off a large load of hay as it was entering a barn, and a wheel rolled over his body and crushed him to death. Following his tragic accident, he was buried in the graveyard located over the harbor.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P18](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0018)_
